newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 1.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on July 1. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Minister of Mines and Energy Ida Bagus Sudjana said the government's proposed changes to seventh generation mining contracts of work (COW) were not yet final.
President Suharto has urged poor families to save money to help finance their children's education.
The Indonesian armed forces said it would not be suspicious of people who are critical to the government.
Indonesia will soon confirm the purchase of Russian-made Sukhoi-30 jet fighters, pending finalisation of two rounds of bilateral talks that will lead to the signing of a memorandum of understanding.
The government's new deregulation package will not touch on the automotive sector and upstream industries.
